From: Iris Beck
To: Mina Cole
Date written: December 29, 1840
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10329
Iris Beck asked Mina Cole to
send the coastal dispatch.

From: Iris Beck
To: Mina Cole
Date written: December 29, 1840
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10329
The depot reported receiving a
copy of the coastal dispatch,
but the sender was not
recorded.
